origin.source: Real Braintrust SDK over the unmodified email-drafter machine, scoring output, XState transitions, and usage with scripted executors

comparison.purpose: Evals observe typed output, transition trajectories, named request calls, and usage while a simulated user drives ordinary idle states.
comparison.requires: A Braintrust account (BRAINTRUST_API_KEY) only to upload the experiment; the eval itself runs locally without one.
